verdict.rationale: Choosing a storage region or data residency is a fair question for a SaaS customer data platform, but nothing in the evidence documents region selection for Segment workspaces or data processing. The Data Storage Destinations (warehouses, S3, GCS) only forward data to your own storage. The privacy and compliance tooling (Privacy Portal, GDPR/HIPAA/CCPA, consent management) is a related feature, not residency control, so neither earns credit.
